Kazakh

[edit]
Alternative scripts
Arabic رومان
Cyrillic роман
Latin roman
Kazakh Wikipedia has an article on:
роман
Wikipedia kk

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Russian рома́н (román), from French roman, from Old French romanz.

Noun

[edit]

роман • (roman)

  1. novel (work of prose fiction)

[edit]

[edit]

рома́н • (román) m inan (genitive рома́ну, nominative plural рома́ни, genitive plural рома́нів)

  1. novel (work of prose fiction)
  2. romance, love affair
